footer_description:
Exploring iEnhancer-2L predictions
and published measurements of enhancer activity.
evidence_labels: Published findings, local observations, and proposed analyses are identified separately.
hero_title: Enhancers: Exploring the signals that control genes
hero_description: Explore our reconstruction of iEnhancer-2L and its first exploratory comparison with measured activity. Agarwal, Inoue et al. (Nature, 2025) tested the same DNA library in HepG2, K562, and WTC11. We have connected 200 previously examined sequences to those measurements; independent evaluation remains pending.
hero_alt: A glowing vertical DNA double helix made of binary digits rotates against a dark background. A continuously looping conceptual animation.
visual_caption: Follow the sequence. Evaluate the evidence.
report_notice: Historical report · 10 October 2026. This report preserves the original strategy. Since then, we have reconstructed iEnhancer-2L and completed an exploratory comparison of 200 previously examined sequences with matched activity measurements from Agarwal, Inoue et al. (Nature, 2025). Independent evaluation remains pending. Follow the current roadmap, reconstruction results, and MCSE archive for present status. The report below retains its original priorities, dates, and counts.

index: The iEnhancer-2L reconstruction, a completed exploratory comparison with three-cell lentiMPRA activity, and the remaining independent-evaluation work.
research: Completed iEnhancer-2L reconstruction and exploratory lentiMPRA comparison, with a roadmap for independent evaluation and remaining data checks.
reproduce: Results from the iEnhancer-2L reconstruction and server comparisons, with a summary of the completed exploratory link to measured reporter activity.
predictor: Paste or upload 200-base DNA sequences and run our saved iEnhancer-2L reconstruction directly in your browser.
experiment: Explore saved model scores beside published lentiMPRA activity in HepG2, K562, and WTC11 using 200 previously examined sequences.
publications: iEnhancer-2L and its experimental connection within twelve collected works: four original papers and eight newer studies.
resources: Original benchmark inputs, the completed 200-sequence lentiMPRA data join, and source collections for future independent evaluation.
notes: Current iEnhancer-2L progress and dated records of earlier analyses, decisions, and unresolved questions.
strategy: Research report 01: enhancer biology, the collected literature, and an analysis-first research strategy.
methods: Reproduce the saved iEnhancer-2L workflow and the exploratory lentiMPRA data join: code, commands, provenance, and analysis limits.
mcse: Archived MCSE-Enhancer results, technical documentation, and the unrun VISTA evaluation plan; the active project focuses on iEnhancer-2L.
